// Issue #4392: Pre-warmed Deno cache for the container image. The Containerfile runs `deno cache --frozen` against this file and its lockfile so the pinned @playwright/mcp (with its own playwright-core) and the worker's JSR dependencies are in the image, then the entrypoint seeds the durable cache from it. Versions here are pins: @playwright/mcp must equal PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_VERSION in worker/deno/setup/screenshot.ts and the JSR entries must equal worker/deno/deno.lock — worker/deno/tests/container_manifest_test.ts fails the gate on drift. @std/internal is pinned explicitly because it is a transitive dependency the worker lock resolves to an exact version; without the pin a fresh resolution would float within its range.
// Issue #14: Mirror worker/deno/deno.json's 24h dependency-age quarantine so a bumped pin here (e.g. @playwright/mcp) cannot adopt a package published less than a day ago — the same cooling-off window the worker's ecosystem already enforces against a compromised/malicious publish.
